description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakePreferences functionality in the OpenClaw project. It tests sanitization, default fallback, size limits, display formatting, and persistence of trigger words.

classes.name: VoiceWakePreferencesTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing various test cases related to VoiceWakePreferences.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsLimitsWordLength
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeTriggerWords enforces maximum word length.
